description: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "8007EF004CA01F51A80BED9D4472A48B", "You trained to move between mists in the veiled paths linking Vek and Nikua camps. Every ridge and turn was felt before seen. You learned to breathe with the fog, to let it wrap around you, to vanish inside it. Few could track you. Fewer could stop you. When the call came to explore Verra, they trusted you to go where others could not.")
name: Anvils_Vek_FogstepScout
